text.tspan: H1 is a principal residence, so no tax
5 debits by priority, each capped at available funds

g.text: [funds below the amount (e.g. pension draw, late in the horizon)]

text.tspan: [priority: derived loan payments (ADR-0029), then costs, then expenses, then transfers, then withdrawals]
after steps 1-8 for every scenario in the set (ADR-0028)

svg.text: 1 open P: carry closed balances and values from P-1
2 rateFor(P) for each rate, converted to monthly via the holding's compounding
2 resolve cash flow amounts for P (indexing + adjustment events)
3 credit inflows first (salary net, rent taxable)
record movements (each rounded 2dp, half-even)
adjust asset value by % or to a set value
sale price (event price, or value carried from P-1)
termAt(P) for M1 and M2
deduct selling costs (price x sellingCostRate)
pay off secured loans + penalty amount if entered (ADR-0047)
debit deficit from proceedsTo, capped, shortfall on the sale
taxOnSale(H2, price, P) gives (price - costBasis) x inclusion x effective rate
remainder to bank (proceedsTo)
H1, H2, M1, M2 closed: their cash flows stop
record sale, payoff, penalty, tax movements
debit full amount
debit available funds (balance = 0)
record SHORTFALL (amount - available)
6 growth and interest on OPENING balances (revalue assets, account returns, mortgage interest)
7 tax on taxable effects (flagged income, taxable account returns, tax-deferred withdrawals)
7 debit tax (same capping and shortfall rule)
7a sweep rules: anything above buffer moves from bank to investments (ADR-0030)
8 close P: snapshot balances, values, cost basis, cumulative shortfall
9 update tallies (holding metrics, net worth, tag sums, derived)
10 evaluate scenario-level goals, then set-level goals (REACH / MAINTAIN)
One month step (ADR-0018 revision 2, Accepted)
